# HagiTask · Community Tasks

> Browse reusable HagiCode community tasks, workflows, and integrations.

## Overview

- [HagiTask · Community Tasks](https://tasks.hagicode.com/): Browse reusable HagiCode community tasks, workflows, and integrations.

## Tasks

- [Add Community Task · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/add-community-task/): Collect one complete Community Task brief, structure it with the prompt, generate every required package file, validate it for real, and open a pull request from your own GitHub fork.
- [AGENTS.md Update · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/agents-md-update/): A structured documentation-maintenance task preset that updates only AGENTS.md with explicit project selection and MonoSpecs-aware repository scope, leaving CLAUDE.md untouched.
- [CodeGraph Tasks · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/codegraph-tasks/): Run localized CodeGraph lifecycle and graph-backed architecture tasks across eligible repositories.
- [GitHub Tasks · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/github-tasks/): Run focused GitHub management commands through gh CLI without persistent local artifacts.
- [Goal · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/goal/): A bundled sustained-work preset that routes work through `/goal` and limits execution to compatible Claude and Codex heroes.
- [HagiCode MonoSpecs Operations · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/hagicode-monospecs-operations/): Initialize MonoSpecs configuration, batch-add repositories, and reorder repositories by observable activity through a structured task.
- [last30days · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/last30days/): A structured research task preset that maps shared preset-task input into a mode-aware `last30days` workflow with explicit repository scope.
- [OpenSpec Spec Compress · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/openspec-spec-compress/): A bundled OpenSpec maintenance preset that turns the documented spec-compression workflow into a reusable, non-interactive task entry.
- [UI Master · HagiTask](https://tasks.hagicode.com/tasks/ui-master/): A structured UI task preset that combines command-guided intent, repository scope, and scene-aware dispatch for focused interface work.
